title: looks_like_bcrypt_hash re-exported from reader::config — accidental public API
description: reader/src/config.rs has 'pub use stoa_auth::looks_like_bcrypt_hash;' — this makes looks_like_bcrypt_hash part of the stoa-reader crate's public API surface, not just stoa-auth's. If a downstream crate imports it from stoa_reader::config, any future rename or removal of the re-export is a breaking change to stoa-reader even if stoa-auth retains it. The function is used internally by reader::config::validate() and does not need to be pub in the reader module. The test file that uses it directly imports from stoa_auth. Remove the pub use; internal callers use stoa_auth::looks_like_bcrypt_hash directly.
